            zeros=sum(grid[rr][cc]==0 for rr in range(r0,r1+1) for cc in range(c0,c1+1))

            empty = True
        marker = next((cc for row in grid for cc,v in enumerate(row) if v == 5), -1)
        marker_row = 2 if empty else min(2, 3-marker//7)
        out.append([color]*zeros+[0]*(3-zeros)+[9,5 if i==marker_row else 0])
    return out
'''
